note: Written before the decision-request routing fix (2026-10-27). Products, numbers, and wording are synthetic. A request whose job is a decision (should we, what should we charge or counter, is a result real, which channels, where should the money go, design a test) routes to the method or play that owns the decision, ahead of methods that only share its keywords (campaign, ads, measure, funnel, decide, convert, prioritize). `lead` names the method or play that must come first: the play when the brief returns one, otherwise the first command. `request` is the decision alone: pasted facts may not change the route. `silent` cases are engineering and must return no brief. `unchanged` cases guard nearby routes that must keep their owner.
